speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma of the head of the pancreas.

The combination of painless jaundice, significant weight loss, pale stools, and dark urine in a 72-year-old male with a 50-year smoking history is highly specific for a malignancy obstructing the common bile duct. The normal readings you mentioned do not alter this clinical picture, which is supported by the request for a CA 19-9 tumor marker and abdominal imaging. I have already requested an Abdominal Ultrasound and Serum Tumor Marker (CA 19-9) to confirm the diagnosis; the results of these tests will definitively identify the mass.
